comment: Failures that existed before the regression harness was added (chapters were never executed under Pyodide). Classified chapter bugs, NOT harness limitations. Remove an entry when its chapter is fixed; run with --strict-baseline to be told about entries that now pass.

known.note: CHAPTER BUG: uses seaborn, which is not in the Pyodide 0.26.4 package set (pyodide-lock.json has no seaborn) and the page loads packages only via loadPackagesFromImports (no micropip), so ModuleNotFoundError in the real browser too (confirmed in headless Chromium).
